title: Land the web lane round 3.2 run evidence
body: Run report, review-gate evidence and 14 worker logs for run 20260820T082911Z on base run/web. Fourteen iterations, 12 pull requests all merged and all App-authored, 8 oracle decisions, 3 plans, one feature slice built by a coder and a blind test-writer in parallel.
